novel_features.name: Kennel rollup
novel_features.description: See which kennels in a breed are actively health-testing young dogs, ranked by tested dogs, CHIC dogs, and latest test date.
novel_features.rationale: Runs one search per report year to defeat OFA's last-value-wins year filter, follows every page, and groups rows by registered-name kennel prefix; no OFA page or single request returns this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent needs to find breeders who test, since OFA exposes no breeder field and no kennel view.

narrative.headline: Look up dogs' OFA health clearances (hips, elbows, eyes, cardiac, DNA) and CHIC status by breed, age, and report year, and roll them up by kennel.
narrative.value_prop: Query OFA's hip, elbow, eye, cardiac, and DNA records from the terminal with every Advanced Search filter. Multi-year searches work correctly (the website keeps only one year per query), every page is fetched, and 'kennels' turns raw records into a ranked list of breeders who actually test.

quickstart.comment: Check that the OFA search backend is reachable.
Find the breed code OFA uses (AUK for Australian Koolie).
List this year's Koolie test records.
Rank kennels testing young Koolies over three report years.
Open one dog's full clearance record, including sire and dam.

troubleshoots.symptom: Multi-year search returns only one year's rows on the website
troubleshoots.fix: Pass years to --report-year as a comma list; the CLI runs one query per year and merges them.

troubleshoots.symptom: Empty results for a breed name
troubleshoots.fix: Use the breed code from 'ofa-health-clearances-pp-cli breeds <name>', not the display name.
The CLI rate-limits to 1 request/second by default; narrow --report-year or --born-from to reduce pages.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to verify a dog's published OFA health clearances, to measure how deeply a breed is health-tested, or to find kennels whose young dogs have recent clearances before contacting breeders. It covers OFA Advanced Search records (hips, elbows, eyes, cardiac, patella, thyroid, DNA) and CHIC status.
anti_triggers: Do not use it to find a breeder's location, contact details, or litters; OFA records carry none of that.
Do not use it to republish or bulk-export OFA data; OFA results are copyrighted and public reproduction needs OFA's permission.
Do not use it for breed-level disease statistics pages or for cats' non-search registries.
